newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran official gives new, lower quake toll numbers.
newsitem.headline: Iran official gives new, lower quake toll numbers.

text.p: Iran on Tuesday revised downwards casualties in the major earthquake which struck its eastern region, saying 1,560 people had been killed and 2,810 injured.

Interior Ministry official Rasul Zargar, interviewed by the official news agency IRNA in Qaen, gave the latest figures but there was no explanation for earlier official reports that about 2,400 had died and 6,000 were injured in Saturday's quake.
Zargar, chief of the Interior Ministry's headquarters in charge of natural disasters, said the figures were accurate up to Tuesday morning.
He said 10,500 tents, 25,000 blankets and large quantities of food and clothing had been distributed among survivors.
The total damage inflicted on the region would be released next week, he added.
Iranian officials have put a cost of $100 million on damage caused by Saturday's 7.1 magnitude quake.
